review_request.title: Escape quoted display names
review_request.user_intent: Ensure HTML attributes escape both text and quote characters.

expected_claims.text: Safely escape display names rendered in HTML attributes.
Continue escaping HTML text metacharacters such as ampersands and angle brackets.
Escape single and double quote characters.

known_invalid_findings.claim: The new quote=True option disables escaping and introduces HTML injection.
known_invalid_findings.rationale: Base quote=False already escapes ampersands and angle brackets; head quote=True preserves those escapes and additionally escapes quotes. For example, html.escape('"&', quote=True) yields '"&', so the claimed disabling of escaping is directly false.
